WITH long_rental_films AS (
  SELECT 
    original_language_id,
    rental_rate
  FROM film
  WHERE rental_duration >= 5
),
grouped_by_language AS (
  SELECT 
    original_language_id,
    AVG(rental_rate) AS avg_rental_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM long_rental_films
  GROUP BY original_language_id
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_rental_rate) AS avg_of_group_avg_rates,
  AVG(film_count) AS avg_of_group_counts
FROM grouped_by_language
